description: Watch one field on a web page for 30 days, e.g. a price, stock status or version number: it is read again every 15 to 1440 minutes and an alert goes to your webhook, Slack, Discord or Telegram when it changes, goes below or above a number, contains a text, or disappears. Returns the current value now; check status or stop it for free with the watch secret. Costs USD 0.10 per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base); calls that fail are not charged.

callback_url.description: Optional https URL for alerts (a signed JSON POST); Slack and Discord incoming webhooks and https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/sendMessage?chat_id=<id> get a readable message. Without it, poll the status.

description.description: What the field is, e.g. the current price of the product

every_minutes.description: How often the page is read (default 60)

field.description: A short name for the field, e.g. price

format.description: Detected from the callback host when left out

label.description: Optional name for your own reference

type.description: The field's type (number for below and above)

value.description: The number for below/above, or the text for contains

when.description: Default changes; below and above compare numbers; contains looks for text in the value; gone fires when the field is no longer on the page

name: watch_field
title: Watch Field
